rules.estimate_rule: Every body that shows a price MUST contain the estimate_label line verbatim (with values filled in). English keeps the literal 'estimated Rs X-Y' so the agent's price normaliser (agent/agent_core.py) leaves it untouched. Hindi deliberately avoids 'Rs'/'₹' before digits so the normaliser does not rewrite it into English.
rules.style: Plain words, short sentences, one emoji at most per line, *bold* only for the key fact. No markdown lists or links. Hindi uses everyday words (पिकअप, कबाड़ीवाला, फ़ोटो) instead of formal Sanskritised Hindi.

body.en:
Namaste! 🌱 I'm EcoLink. I help you sell or recycle household waste, and book a kabadiwala pickup.

Which language do you prefer?
आप किस भाषा में बात करना चाहेंगे?
body.hi:
नमस्ते! 🌱 मैं EcoLink हूँ। मैं घर का कबाड़ बेचने, रीसायकल करने और कबाड़ीवाला पिकअप बुक करने में मदद करता हूँ।

Which language do you prefer?
आप किस भाषा में बात करना चाहेंगे?

body.en:
What would you like to clear out today?

voice.description: Phone offer read to a recycler (POST /voice/offer). Spoken in the recycler's language (recyclers.lang). Never contains the household address, name, phone or photo.

offer.en: Namaste! This is EcoLink. A new pickup near you: {items_spoken}, {weight_spoken} kilos, {distance_spoken} kilometres away, {slot_spoken}. To accept, press 1. To decline, press 2.
offer.hi: नमस्ते! EcoLink से कॉल है। आपके पास नया पिकअप है: {items_spoken}, {weight_spoken} किलो, {distance_spoken} किलोमीटर दूर, {slot_spoken}। स्वीकार करने के लिए 1 दबाएँ। मना करने के लिए 2 दबाएँ।

repeat.en: Press 1 to accept, or 2 to decline.
repeat.hi: स्वीकार के लिए 1, मना करने के लिए 2 दबाएँ।

accepted.en: Thank you! Pickup confirmed. The address is coming to you on WhatsApp now.
accepted.hi: धन्यवाद! पिकअप पक्का हो गया। पता अभी आपको WhatsApp पर भेज रहे हैं।

invalid_key.en: Sorry, please press 1 to accept or 2 to decline.
invalid_key.hi: माफ़ कीजिए, स्वीकार के लिए 1 या मना करने के लिए 2 दबाएँ।

no_input_goodbye.en: We did not get a response. We will offer this pickup to someone else. Goodbye.
no_input_goodbye.hi: हमें जवाब नहीं मिला। यह पिकअप किसी और को दिया जाएगा। नमस्ते।

call_sequence: Digit 1 -> POST /voice/response {pickup_id, digit:'1'} -> play scripts.accepted -> hang up (status confirmed; address sent by WhatsApp)
Digit 2 -> POST /voice/response {pickup_id, digit:'2'} -> play scripts.declined -> hang up (status declined; agent tries next recycler)
Other digit -> play scripts.invalid_key -> Gather again (once)
No input -> play scripts.repeat inside Gather (once) -> still nothing -> scripts.no_input_goodbye (treated as decline)
